comparison: S1 versus formal 200k B1 and S0 on exactly identical training endpoint IDs, dev/evaluation original-event IDs, five causal features, context32 and h20 target
configuration_search: One prespecified configuration; no architecture/hyperparameter selection from exposed evaluation dates. April dev controls only early stopping.

transformer.position: learned absolute position within each 32-state window
transformer.attention: strict causal upper-triangle mask, last-token readout; no state across windows
transformer.loss: squared error on training-standardized bp h20 target

budget: Five single-GPU stock tasks, each at most three hours allocated wall time; target <=15 total allocated GPU-hours. If the declared allocation is exhausted or training remains limited, report it rather than shrinking data or tuning on evaluation dates.
primary_score: Equal-stock then equal-shared-date Spearman IC, three-seed S1 mean of seed ICs compared pairwise with formal B1 and S0 seed-mean on the same 315 exposed stock/day cells
exposure: April is dev; June/September/November and all five stocks were previously inspected. This is retrospective/exploratory and no independent confirmation or trading-PnL claim is authorized.
